notes:
Summary: Large regional health system (12 hospitals + ambulatory network) evaluating Redwood for RAG-powered clinical search across EHR notes and imaging reports. Primary goals: accelerate clinician time-to-answer, reduce duplicate tests, improve coding accuracy for billing audits.

Key requirements (from CTO/CISO/Head of Clinical Informatics):
- Index scale: ~80M clinical notes + 12M structured encounter summaries (estimate), ~2TB embeddings after vectorization.
- Latency: p50 < 80ms for vector lookup; p99 end-to-end (search + rerank) < 350ms for urgent queries. Prefer p99 < 200ms for clinician-facing flows.
- Cost sensitivity: target avg cost-per-query < $0.005 for standard searches; willing to pay more for cross-encoder rerank on top 20 hits for critical workflows.
- Reranking: cross-encoder for precision in diagnosis retrieval; warm GPU-based reranker for top-K; fallback to lightweight ranker for cost control.
- Data controls: Must handle PHI. SSO/SAML, strict RBAC, per-request audit logs, KMS integration, retention controls, ability to run Private (VPC) or on-prem for air-gapped facilities.
- Network: VPC peering or private link; no public internet egress for primary dataset.
- Compliance: need documentation for SOC2, ISO27001, and CNDA-style DUA.

Quote from CISO on 2026-02-18 call: "We cannot accept any third-party that doesn't provide per-request auditing and key separation. No exceptions for core patient data."

POC plan (6 weeks):
- Week 1: security & connectivity (trial VPC, DPA in place).
- Week 2-3: ingest 18 months of EHR notes (12 hospitals), build embedding index, initial vector store sizing.
- Week 4: integration of cross-encoder reranker (sample model provided by Redwood or bring-your-own).
- Week 5: latency tuning, batching & caching config, cost simulation run.
- Week 6: clinician validation sessions + quality metrics (precision@5, MRR, latency SLOs).

Stated constraints / internal blockers: legal needs DPA + DUA approval before POC data is provisioned. Procurement asks for trial pricing tied to max QPS and storage. Security needs SIEM ingestion format and proof of key custody. Team will require a private deployment option for phase 2 (on-prem for sensitive hospital).

Misc links: Pricing deck in Drive, security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-20, Fireflies transcript available (ff_2026-02-18). Jira INF-4821 created for masking/PII pipeline questions.
